g.text: SEQUENCE 1 - LUONG THI VIVA (Viva Exam Flow)
Giai doan 1: Bat dau ca thi
Session, CurrentQuestionIndex, danh sach cau hoi
[Chua ghi danh / ngoai khung gio thi]
"Chua du dieu kien thi - thong bao loi"
Hien thi cau hoi + thong bao mau
Giai doan 2: Ghi am & nop cau tra loi
Luong chunked: nen cho ban ghi
- AI tu keo audio tu R2 bang
Hien thi feedback + cau tiep theo
Giai doan 3: Ket thuc ca thi
